title: सुशासन, विकास र स्थानीय सरकारः एक अध्ययन {Governance, Development and Local Government: A Study}
nepali: सुशासन असल कार्यसँग सम्बन्धित छ । सरोकारका सबै पक्षको उपस्थितिमा आवश्यक्ता पहिचान गर्ने र सबैले थाहा पाउने गरी कार्य सम्पादन गर्ने शैली सुशासन हुन्छ । किन भयो, कति भयो, के भयो, कसरी भयो र केका लागि भयो जस्ता प्रश्नको उत्तर सहित सम्पन्न हुने कार्य सुशासन हो । जनचाहना र आवश्यकताहरूको आपूर्तिमा हुने सापेक्षित बृद्धिको अवस्था विकास हुन्छ । आवश्यक्ता सापेक्ष आपूर्ति भयो वा भएन भन्ने प्रश्न विकाससँग सम्बन्धित हुन्छ । यस सन्दर्भमा सुशासन, विकास र स्थानीय सरकारबीच के अन्तरसम्बन्ध हुन्छ ? सुशासन र बिकासको सापेक्षमा भोजपुर नगरपालिका र आमचौक गाउँपालिकाको अवस्था कस्तो रहेको छ ? यो आलेखमा यी प्रश्नहरूको उत्तर खोज्ने प्रयास भएको छ । इमान्दारिता, पारदर्शिता र सहभागिताका साथै शक्तिविन्यास सहमतिको राजनीतिक वातावरणबाट मात्र विकासको प्रादुर्भाव हुन्छ भन्ने यो आलेखको निष्कर्ष हो । । वर्णनात्मक ढाँचाबाट तयार गरिएको यो आलेख गुणात्मक स्वरूपमा रहेको छ । यो द्वितीय श्रोतबाट प्राप्त भएको तथ्याङ्कको उपयोगमा आधारित छ । बिभिन्न वेभसाईट, पुस्तक र जर्नल द्वितीय स्रोतका रूपमा उपयोग गरिएको छ । एपिए पब्लिकेसन म्यानुअल, छैठौं संस्करण अनुसरण गरी साइटेसन, कोटेसन र रिफरेन्स तयार गरिएको छ ।
american_english: Good governance is related to good work. The style of identifying needs in the presence of all stakeholders and carrying out work so that everyone knows is good governance. Work completed with answers to questions such as why it happened, how much happened, what happened, how it happened and for what purpose is good governance. The state of relative growth in the supply of public desires and needs is development. The question of whether needs were supplied relative to requirements or not is related to development. In this context, what is the interrelationship among good governance, development and local government? What is the state of Bhojpur Municipality and Amchok Rural Municipality in relation to good governance and development? This article has attempted to find answers to these questions. The conclusion of this article is that development arises only from a political environment of honesty, transparency and participation, along with agreed power-sharing. Prepared in a descriptive format, this article is qualitative in nature. It is based on the use of data obtained from secondary sources. Various websites, books and journals have been used as secondary sources. Citations, quotations and references have been prepared following the APA Publication Manual, sixth edition.

informal_english: Good governance is basically about doing good work. It's the style of figuring out what's needed with everyone involved and doing things so everyone knows what's going on. Work that's finished with answers to why, how much, what, how and what for is good governance. Development is basically the relative growth in meeting people's wants and needs. Whether needs got met relative to requirements or not is tied to development. So, in this context, what's the interrelationship among good governance, development and local government? And what's the state of Bhojpur Municipality and Amchok Rural Municipality when it comes to good governance and development? This article tries to answer those questions. Its conclusion is that development only comes about from a political environment of honesty, transparency and participation, along with agreed power-sharing. This article is qualitative in nature and was put together in a descriptive format. It's based on data from secondary sources. Various websites, books and journals were used as secondary sources. Citations, quotations and references were prepared following the APA Publication Manual, sixth edition.
